exposure: treatment in secondary and tertiary facilities
cohort: The study included 3025 women in Kenya who experienced maternal near misses during pregnancy and childbirth or within 42 days of delivery or termination of pregnancy, admitted to referral facilities.
finding: The median cost of treating maternal near misses (7135 Kenyan shillings) was significantly higher than for potentially life-threatening conditions (2690 Kenyan shillings), with 26.4% of women making out-of-pocket payments experiencing catastrophic expenditure.
followup_time: 42 days post-delivery or termination of pregnancy
